Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA for the State contends that the police authorities in compliance of the directions issued by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 46998 of 2020 (Junaid Vs State of U.P. and another) reported at 2021 (6) ADJ 511 and with a view to implement the provisions of POCSO Act, 2012 read with POCSO Rules, 2020, have served the bail application upon the victim/legal guardian as well as upon the CWC.

sentences.text:
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.418 of 2021 at Police Station-Kotwali, District-Fatehpur under Sections 363, 366, 376, 323, 504,
506 IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 20.06.2021.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 29.10.2021.

sentences.text:
The following arguments made by Shri Sunil Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the minority of the victim as depicted in the prosecution case.
2. The victim was wrongly shown as a minor of 15 years in the F.I.R. only to falsely implicate the applicant under the stringent provisions of the POCSO Act and cause his imprisonment.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the age of the victim set out in the prosecution case in light of the judgement of this Court in Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021) and on the following grounds:
(i) There are material contradictions in the age of the victim as recorded in various prosecution documents.

entities.text:
Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) The victim under in her statements under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. has stated that she is 15 years of age.
(iii) The medical report drawn up to determine the age of the victim opines that she is between 15 to 16 years of age.
Two submissions are made in regard to the aforesaid medical report.
Firstly, the range of error in determining the age is about two years and the same should be read in favour of the applicant at this stage.
Secondly, the relevant scientific parameters as per latest medical protocol which would establish the majority of the victim has been excluded from consideration in the medical report.
The medical report is flawed.
In fact the victim is a major.
4. The delay of 27 days in lodgment of the F.I.R. in the facts and circumstances of the case is fatal to the prosecution case.
5. The victim got married to the nephew of the applicant of her own volition.
The pictures of the wedding at the temple are appended to the bail application.
6. The parents of the victim were opposed to the said relationship and the wedding.
7. The victim was tutored to give statement against the applicant by her parents to deflect attention from her conduct and saving the prosecution case.
8. Medical evidence to corroborate the commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.

sentences.text: The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
10. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Rajendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Rajendra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168790398/
